programme.title: BBC Proms
programme.sub-title: The Great American Songbook with Samara Joy
programme.desc: Andi Oliver presents a BBC Proms concert in which American jazz singer Samara Joy and her octet join the BBC Concert Orchestra and conductor Miho Hazama to perform classic songs and musical standards at the Royal Albert Hall. Fresh from another double win at this year's Grammys, Joy makes her much-anticipated Proms debut, introducing audiences to her electric combination of youthful energy and old-soul musical style with classic songs and unique twists on instrumental classics from across jazz and its fringes, from bossa nova to the Great American Songbook. She salutes figures including Sarah Vaughan, Ella Fitzgerald, Duke Ellington, Billie Holiday, Charles Mingus and Oscar Peterson. Nacio Herb Brown: You Stepped out of a Dream. Hoagy Carmichael: Stardust Davis, Ramirez and Sherman: Loverman (Oh Where Can You Be). Erroll Garner: Misty. Thelonius Monk: Worry Later (San Francisco Holiday). Billie Holiday and Max Waldron: Left Alone. Axel Stordahl and Paul Weston: Day by Day. Interval: Jazz singer and broadcaster Clare Teal joins Petroc to reflect on Samara Joy's Proms debut and to discuss the enduring fascination of the Great American Songbook. Betty Carter: Beware My Heart. Duke Ellington: I Got it Bad and That Ain't Good. Sun Ra, Samara Joy, Jae Mayo & Kendric McCallister: Peace of Mind/Dreams Come True. Samara Joy and Kendric Mccallister: Five Stages of Love (Love's Impression). Teddy Wilson and Harold Adamson: It's the Little Things that Mean So Much Monk: Ugly Beauty. Jobim: Chega de Saudade (No More Blues). Samara Joy (singer), Samara Joy Octet, BBC Concert Orchestra, conductor Miho Hazama

He heads to Vietnam, which is the UK's biggest supplier, and travels to the remote central highlands where he meets some of the millions who grow, pick and pack the beans for instant coffee brands. The boom in the industry has made some people very rich, but Simon learns that the rapid success has come at a cost to both the locals and the environment

programme.title: MOTD Live: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Colombia v Portugal (Kick-off 12.30am). Gabby Logan presents all the action from both teams' third and final match in Group K, held at Miami Stadium in the USA.. Perhaps surprisingly given both teams have made a number of appearances in this competition over the years, this is the first meeting between the nations. Colombia find themselves at the top of the group after two wins from two, while Portugal are currently second with four points. A draw would be enough for both sides to progress to the knock-out stages, however if Portugal were to lose it would open the door for DR Congo to finish second if they were to beat Uzbekistan in the other Group K game tonight. With analysis from Wayne Rooney, Micah Richards and Lucas Leiva

programme.title: MOTD Live: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: New Zealand v Belgium (Kick-off 4.00am). Group G reaches a climax at BC Place Vancouver in Canada, with this first-ever meeting between the nations. It's perhaps not surprising that this is a first encounter, as the All Whites have only reached the World Cup finals on two previous occasions, the first of which was a memorable campaign back in 1982, when they lost all three matches but still managed to play a part in Scotland being eliminated at the first hurdle once again. Belgium are unlikely to have as much attention focused on them this time than in recent years, when they were often tipped for success, but that may remove some of the pressure that has weighed so heavily on their shoulders. Both of these sides need a victory here to have any chance of progressing to the knock-out stages, with the top two in the group facing each other in the other group match taking place tonight. New Zealand find themselves bottom of Group G with one point, while Belgium are third after two successive draws

programme.title: MOTD Live: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Algeria v Austria (Kick-off 3.00am). Coverage of the Group J match at Kansas City Stadium in the USA, as both sides play their final group game. This is just the second meeting between these two teams, with the previous coming 44 years ago in the first group stage of the 1982 World Cup. That fixture saw Austria come away with a 2-0 victory, which helped them progress to the next stage of the tournament at the expense of the Algerians in controversial circumstances. Austria and West Germany knew that a 1-0 win for the Germans in the final group game between the nations would see both teams progress, and so they played out the match without serious attempts to score once the Germans took the lead. This game became known as the 'Disgrace of Gijon' and led to FIFA changing the rules for future tournaments, with all final group games being held simultaneously to avoid a reoccurrence. Both of these teams have three points going into this last game and whoever wins here will finish second in the group behind Argentina. Austria have the slight advantage though and will finish second here if they avoid defeat due to their superior goal difference

programme.title: Egypt's Darkest Hour
programme.desc: Part one of two. Over 4,000 years ago, the ancient kingdom of Egypt, collapsed and disappeared. The mighty pharaohs, who had reigned supreme for more than seven centuries, lost control and the land was plunged into 150 years of chaos and civil war. In this documentary, a team of archaeologists examines the Tomb of the Warriors, a rare mass grave dating to the fall of the Old Kingdom, when political infighting and a changing climate brought down an empire

programme.title: Egypt's Darkest Hour
programme.desc: Part two of two. The Tomb of the Warriors, near Luxor in southern Egypt, contains over 60 mummified bodies, all of which had suffered violent deaths. Though discovered in 1923 before being sealed, the tomb has only recently been investigated for what it can reveal of this lost world

programme.title: Ancient Egypt: Life and Death in the Valley of the Kings
programme.desc: Egyptologist Joann Fletcher looks at the lives of ordinary Egyptian citizens 3,500 years ago. In the first of two programmes, she explores the conditions of their tightly packed houses, how they dressed and what they ate. Joann also examines their love of poetry, their enthusiasm for interior design and what it was like to work in the Valley of the Kings, where the pharaohs were entombed

programme.title: Ancient Egypt: Life and Death in the Valley of the Kings
programme.desc: Part two of two. Joann Fletcher investigates the Ancient Egyptian attitude to death, revealing that to them life was just a dress rehearsal for the perfect afterlife that they were trying to reach. Joann clambers into rarely visited tombs, explores a treasure trove of long-buried objects and examines mummies to discover just why they spent a fortune preparing for death - and what they hoped to find when they got there

programme.title: The M Factor: Shredding the Silence on Menopause
programme.desc: Menopause is a silent epidemic that affects the health and wellbeing of millions of women. In addition to experiencing traumatic physical symptoms, women often struggle with related emotional stresses. Despite its universality, menopause remains mired in silence and misinformation, exacerbating the broader crisis in women's health. Symptoms can derail careers, disrupt relationships and cause unnecessary physical suffering. This film confronts this neglected crisis, challenges societal and medical misunderstandings, and advocates for a revolutionary approach to women's health

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 26 Live
programme.desc: Cape Verde v Saudi Arabia (Kick-off 1.00am). All the action from both teams' third and final Group H match, held at Houston Stadium in the USA. Uruguay and Spain were the two favourites to qualify from this group, but even if both of these sides have failed to collect a point so far, with eight of the 12 third-placed teams qualifying for the last 32, three points here could be enough to see either one of them progress. The only time the Saudis managed to reach the knockout stage was in 1994, when the United States served as hosts, while this is the first time Cape Verde have played in the finals. Both of these sides still have a chance of progressing to the knock-out stages and a victory here may well do the job. Cape Verde are currently third in the group with two points, while Saudi Arabia are bottom with one, but the result in the other game between Spain and Uruguay may affect what happens to these teams

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 26 Live
programme.desc: Panama v England (Kick-off 10.00pm). Coverage of the Group L match at New York/New Jersey Stadium in the USA, as the two sides play their final group game. This is just the second ever meeting between the two countries, with the first coming in the group stage of the 2018 World Cup in Russia. That game was a memorable one for the Three Lions as they brushed their opponents aside with a 6-1 victory. Braces from Harry Kane and John Stones, as well as a goal from Jesse Lingard, gave England a 5-0 lead at half-time before Kane completed his hat-trick in the second period. Panama did create some history in the second half as they scored their first ever goal at the World Cup thanks to a consolation finish from Felipe Baloy. The Three Lions will be hoping to finish top of this group with victory here after they missed their chance to progress to the knock-out stages in their last game against Ghana, as they were held to a 0-0 draw by the African country. Panama are already out of the competition after two 1-0 defeats by Ghana and Croatia.Tony O'Donoghue presents, with analysis from Kevin Doyle

Belgium are unlikely to have as much attention focused on them this time than in recent years, when they were often tipped for success, but that may remove some of the pressure that has weighed so heavily on their shoulders. Meanwhile, Andy Cramed pays an unexpected visit to Tolliver. Starring Ian McShane and Robin Weigert

programme.title: Deadwood
programme.desc: Emmy award-winner Brian Cox joins the cast as a flamboyant stage promoter on a mission to introduce a modicum of culture to the residents of the gold-rush town. Hearst's long-serving cook also makes an appearance as the Grand Central chef, and Wu returns with news of a soon-to-arrive group of imported workers. Meanwhile, Bullock uncovers the truth about the Gem killings. Cleo King guest stars

programme.title: Deadwood
programme.desc: As George Hearst threatens to ruin everything that has been established in Deadwood, Swearengen chooses Adams to be his deputy in his dealings with the ruthless mining baron. Harry is persuaded by Nuttall to start a fire-wagon rental business, Langrishe comes up against competition in buying Chez Ami, and Alma Garrett opens the town's first bank amid as much fanfare as the inhabitants can muster

programme.title: Urban Secrets
programme.desc: Alan Cumming visits Glasgow, one of his favourite cities, to reveal unusual and often hidden sights and sounds overlooked by the public. Starting at the Necropolis, he travels to the world's oldest music hall before enjoying the views from a city-centre landmark. He also finds the time to take tea with a film star

programme.title: The Guest Wing
programme.desc: Documentary following stately home owners who hire out their estates to earn extra income, and the clients who pay to use their properties for functions including stag parties, weddings and hunting trips. The programme explores how the reality of life in Britain's grand houses is often less glamorous than it appears, as proprietors struggle to maintain crumbling buildings and pay utility bills, and examines the modern-day divide between domestic staff and their employers. Featuring life at Chillingham Castle, Maunsel House, Carlton Towers and Muncaster Castle

programme.title: Richard E Grant's Hotel Secrets
programme.desc: The actor returns to explore more of the world's most luxurious hotels and begins in Miami's South Beach, home to some of the most hedonistic and extravagant establishments in America. At the Fontainebleau, he meets a man with eye-opening stories about Frank Sinatra's regular visits and gets a shock when he discovers how much it costs to hire a booth in the night club. Richard also gatecrashes swimwear fashion week at the Raleigh Hotel, where he speaks to the event manager about the many celebrity parties he has organised

programme.title: Richard E Grant's Hotel Secrets
programme.desc: In this edition the actor explores the luxury hotels of Hong Kong. Home to more skyscrapers than any other city, he first checks in to the Mandarin in the financial district, before experiencing the Four Seasons, the only hotel with two Michelin three-star resturants, as well as the timeless Peninsula in Kowloon, which even provides a Rolls-Royce airport taxi service. He ends his stay at the Ritz-Carlton, home to the world's highest swimming pool

programme.title: Billions
programme.desc: Axe tries for a fresh start at Axe Capital, and Chuck asserts his political autonomy and wrestles with whether to honour his word to a friend

programme.title: Gomorrah
programme.desc: As Imma begins to restructure the Savastano business empire, Ciro realises the new leader has Pietro's blessing, so he has no choice but to fall in line with her regime. She quickly proves herself when one of the clan is killed, and her plotting ensures a rival gang member ends up behind bars. But things look set to change when Genny returns home from Honduras unexpectedly. Italian crime drama, starring Marco D'Amore and Maria Pia Calzone. In Italian

programme.title: Gomorrah
programme.desc: Genny is a new man after his return from Honduras and turns his back on his family as he leads a campaign to replace the city's mayor. Willing to use every method in the book, from libel and slander to vote rigging - and even murder if necessary - Genny is determined to appoint someone of his choosing. However, expecting former mentor Ciro to bow to his demands might be a step too far. Italian crime drama, starring Marco D'Amore and Salvatore Esposito. In Italian

programme.title: Gomorrah
programme.desc: Genny plans to lead the gang towards a bright and prosperous future, but Ciro throws a spanner in the works by setting up one of his followers to kill Salvatore Conte's right-hand man in Naples. Genny sends out word that he had nothing to do with the hit, fully aware of its potentially disastrous consequences: for him and the entire clan. Starring Marco D'Amore and Salvatore Esposito Genny. In Italian

programme.title: Gomorrah
programme.desc: Major bloodshed, if not all-out war, is imminent as Conte returns to Naples to avenge Giuliano's murder, and Ciro weaves his web further around Genny to distract him from the coup he is plotting. Imma receives a visit from Daniele's desperate mother, who begs her to spare her son's life - but Conte also has him in his sights. Italian crime drama, starring Marco D'Amore. In Italian

programme.title: Gomorrah
programme.desc: Genny is cornered when the Savastanos' rivals rally around Conte to help exact revenge for Daniele's death, and he also faces trouble within his own ranks as a deadly battle erupts between his supporters and the old lieutenants. Imma is forced to intervene and manages to establish a fragile order within the clan, as well as realising that Ciro is behind this war. Italian crime drama, starring Maria Pia Calzone and Salvatore Esposito

programme.title: Gomorrah
programme.desc: War breaks out on the streets of Naples and Ciro flees to Rome with his wife and daughter as both clans barricade themselves in their apartment bunkers, entering into a lethal stalemate. Meanwhile, a vengeful Genny hunts down Ciro, intent on seeking justice for his betrayal. Italian crime drama, starring Marco D'Amore and Salvatore Esposito. In Italian

programme.title: The White Lotus
programme.desc: Ethan grows suspicious of Cam, Tanya gives Portia a warning about Jack, and Lucia helps the Di Grassos search for long-lost relatives

programme.title: The White Lotus
programme.desc: Albie asks Dominic for a karmic payment to help Lucia, Tanya grows wary of Quentin's motives, Ethan confronts Cam, and Valentina gives Mia a chance

programme.title: The White Lotus
programme.desc: At the Thailand resort, Belinda settles in, Chelsea deals with a moody Rick, the Ratliffs go separate ways, and Kate, Laurie and Jaclyn kick off a girls' trip

programme.title: The White Lotus
programme.desc: Kate and Jaclyn discuss Laurie's divorce while Timothy gets bad business news. Rick shares trauma during meditation with Amrita, and Chelsea bonds with Chloe

programme.title: The White Lotus
programme.desc: Saxon gets work calls, so Timothy enforces a no-phone rule, Chelsea faces danger after going to town with Rick, and Jaclyn pushes Laurie toward Valentin

programme.title: House of the Dragon
programme.sub-title: Salt and Sea, Fire and Blood
programme.desc: Driven by her faith in Alicent, Rhaenyra positions herself to take King's Landing, while the Triarchy sails to take on Corlys in the Gullet. Return of the Game of Thrones prequel, starring Matt Smith and Emma D'Arcy

programme.title: Task
programme.desc: As Robbie and Cliff try to find a potential buyer, Tom and Grasso level with the Dark Hearts, and Aleah and Lizzie question Peaches' former co-workers. Later, a raid leads Tom to a shocking revelation

programme.title: The Fear Index
programme.desc: As VIXAL-4 exceeds its programming limits, Dr Hoffman races against the clock to stop what he might have inadvertently started. Thriller, starring Josh Hartnett

programme.title: Hacks

programme.title: Deadwood
programme.desc: Following the opening of the bank, Alma charms Merrick into endorsing her liquidity, and it isn't long before she reverts to her old ways. Swearengen tries to figure out Hearst's intentions as he finally finds a use for Farnum. Meanwhile, two more actors arrive in town to be reunited with Langrishe as the troupe prepares to transform Chez Ami into a theatre. Ian McShane stars

programme.title: House of the Dragon
programme.desc: Game of Thrones prequel following the story of House Targaryen, set 200 years before the events of the fantasy saga. Matt Smith and Emma D'Arcy star

programme.desc: Chuck's probe is temporarily derailed by a new investigation into Steven Birch, while Axe makes an aggressive business move under the guise of a charitable contribution in order to settle an old score. Drama, Paul Giamatti and Damian Lewis star

programme.title: The Guest Wing
programme.desc: Lord and Lady Fitzalan Howard, the owners of Carlton Towers near Selby in North Yorkshire, prepare to host a fitness boot camp weekend at their property - while also welcoming an array of guests to celebrate their son's birthday. Meanwhile, Sir Benjamin Slade hopes a murder mystery weekend at Maunsel House in Somerset will help pay off a sizeable electricity bill

programme.title: Minions (2015)
programme.desc: A race of strange, babbling yellow creatures has served the cause of evil throughout the history of the world. programme.desc: Decades on from the creation of Jurassic Park, a fully operational attraction filled with genetically engineered dinosaurs has been opened on the island. Action adventure sequel, starring Chris Pratt and Bryce Dallas Howard

programme.desc: A documentary tribute to the influential and much-missed comedian, a man driven by punk spirit and an unrelenting commitment to pushing boundaries. When he died in 2014 at the age of 56, Rik left behind a body of ground-breaking work, from Rick the Poet and Kevin Turvey to The Young Ones, Bottom and The New Statesman - performances that redefined television comedy and helped ignite the alternative comedy revolution. The film explores his comedic journey, his creative partnership with Adrian Edmondson, his struggle with drink and the near-fatal quad-bike accident that left him fighting not only for his life but also his future. He played hapless father Clark Griswold in the National Lampoon films and ran amok in pictures including Caddyshack, Spies Like Us, Fletch and Three Amigos. Two-time Emmy Award winner Marina Zenovich directs an authorised feature-length documentary portrait of Chase, which includes rare and intimate home movies and archive footage. Chase and his family share memories directly to camera, enriched with contributions from friends and collaborators including Dan Aykroyd, Beverly D'Angelo, Goldie Hawn, Lorne Michaels, Ryan Reynolds and Martin Short.

More than 150 years after Charles Darwin formulated his ground-breaking theory of evolution on the remote archipelago, Attenborough explains how life on the islands has continued to evolve in biological isolation, examining how the ever-changing volcanic landscape has given birth to species and sub-species that exist nowhere else in the world. He begins by revealing how Galapagos rose from the ocean four million years ago

programme.title: David Attenborough's Galapagos
programme.desc: The broadcaster reveals how life has learnt to adapt quickly in the ever-changing volcanic landscape, resulting in species that exist nowhere else in the world. David investigates the driving forces behind their evolution, exploring the appearance and behaviour of remarkable creatures and vegetation including giant whale sharks, marine iguanas and seemingly normal dandelion seeds that grow into plants the size of trees

programme.title: David Attenborough's Galapagos
programme.desc: The broadcaster concludes his exploration of the archipelago with a look at how, despite their proximity, no two of the 19 islands are the same. He also uncovers evidence that evolution on Galapagos is occurring faster than Charles Darwin could ever have imagined, and encounters Lonesome George, the last remaining giant Pinta Island tortoise, who died just a few weeks after filming in June 2012

programme.title: Micro Monsters with David Attenborough

Highlights include scorpions shaking their booty, the perfume-wearing nasonia wasp and the tropical cricket, for whom romance goes out of the window as it uses bribery to seal the deal with would-be partners. One potential partner to steer well clear of, however, is the praying mantis, the female of which is notorious for eating the male just after - or even during - mating. Narrated by David Attenborough

programme.title: Micro Monsters with David Attenborough
programme.desc: A close-up view of sex, bug-style, as David Attenborough talks viewers through the different ways in which creepy-crawlies reproduce. Size matters for the minuscule male orb spider, creepily sneaking up on its intended and trying to mate without her noticing, while there's no rest for the lothario-like butterfly, which has plenty of notches on its proverbial bedpost. However, the harvestman spider has no use for sex at all, and reproduces by cloning itself

programme.title: Micro Monsters with David Attenborough

programme.title: Micro Monsters with David Attenborough

During this trip, Bob and Paul meet Mick May and Marina Gibson, who together have started a charity called Cancer and Pisces, which offers fishing as therapeutic respite for people with cancer

programme.title: Mortimer & Whitehouse: Gone Fishing
programme.desc: Paul and Bob are on the River Severn in Worcestershire to fish for zander, and enlist the help of local guide Tim Maslen to find the best spots. As they sit and wait, they ruminate on the state of Britain's rivers in general, the threats that they are under and what it takes to do something to help them improve. After a few hours they move down the river to a secluded beach and meet their special guest - local actor and self-confessed fishing addict Charlie Cooper, star of This Country

programme.title: Mortimer & Whitehouse: Gone Fishing

They are joined on the riverbank by former footballer Paul Gascoigne, who has also always dreamt of catching a salmon, while Dr Anand Patel has a chat with Bob about how to look out for the more vulnerable at Christmastime

programme.title: Mortimer & Whitehouse: Gone Fishing
programme.desc: Paul Whitehouse and Bob Mortimer head to the River Exe in Devon, where they fish for summer grilse, and a trip to the beach sees them try their hand at shore fishing. Away from the fishing, Bob finds a shady corner to prepare a vegan lunch for them both, using a special blend of car meat, and as the day draws to a close they head back to their accommodation and enjoy a game of cricket on the lawn, in which Bob proves himself to be surprisingly agile

programme.title: Mortimer & Whitehouse: Gone Fishing
programme.desc: Bob and Paul travel to the Crogen Estate in north Wales to fish the River Dee for grayling, a fish that has so far eluded Paul on their extensive travels. They fish hard on a secluded private estate, with Bob displaying some very balletic moves in the river while Paul tries hard to concentrate on landing the prized fish. While Paul continues to fish, Bob decides to set up a bijou coffee shop to refresh his friend

programme.desc: Beech wins a big hand at poker, only to find himself drawn into a much tougher game than he bargained for, where the stakes are high and danger lurks at every turn. Drama, starring Billy Murray

programme.title: Call the Midwife
programme.desc: Sister Julienne decides it is time to take matters in hand when a letter arrives from the council saying that it will cut funding to Nonnatus House and no longer pay for the accommodation, and goes to see Violet at one of her open sessions as a local councillor. At clinic, Nurse Crane meets and cares for heavily pregnant Bonnie, who is not married but committed to the baby's father Eddie, while Kevin's dependency on pain relief is discovered by the team and Dr Turner and Miss Higgins must find a way to help him

programme.title: Call the Midwife
programme.desc: Controversial plans are afoot to introduce a private clinic to Nonnatus House. The proposition leads to the first disagreement in 20 years between Sister Julienne, who sees the potential to generate income, and Dr Turner, who opposes private healthcare on principle. Shelagh feels caught in the middle of their conflict, while Trixie is delighted by the opportunity of working at the new clinic. Sister Monica Joan's crisis of faith continues to trouble her, a baby is born with no legs below the knees, and Lucille helps Cyril find the perfect accommodation that will benefit him and the Church

programme.title: Catherine Cookson's The Moth
programme.desc: Feature-length version of the drama set at the turn of the 20th century, about the fortunes of a carpenter who moves to the country to start work in his uncle's furniture business, but finds himself forced to seek employment with a beguiling woman known locally as the Moth. Jack Davenport and Justine Waddell star

programme.title: Home Fires
programme.desc: As the war in Europe draws closer to home and the nation faces its darkest hour, the members of the WI find they have their own battles to fight. Alison looks for a way out of her desperate situation, and Frances tries to help Pat while she still can. Miriam keeps an important piece of news from Bryn, and Richard and Laura realise it may not be possible to keep their affair a secret any longer. Conclusion of the Second World War drama, starring Fenella Woolgar and Francesca Annis

programme.title: Hetty Wainthropp Investigates
programme.desc: The detectives find themselves swamped with work after their recent success. Hetty turns her attention to a troubled village, while Robert and Geoffrey embark on a case of their own. Private eye drama based on the novel by David Cook, starring Patricia Routledge and Derek Benfield

programme.title: Sister Boniface Mysteries
programme.desc: The part-time sleuth is surprised by a visit from her mother, who is worried about her husband's obsession with a belief that catastrophic events relating to the Cold War are being planned at the British open chess championships. Sister Boniface decides to brush up on her chess skills and enter the tournament. Lorna Watson stars

programme.title: Silent Witness
programme.desc: Fresh from her trip to the US, Nikki and the Lyell unit are called to investigate an attack against a transgender man. When two further attacks are reported, one leaving a potential witness, it looks like the team are facing an outbreak of violence

programme.title: New Tricks
programme.desc: The discovery of a Roman sword with traces of blood on it is linked to an unidentified, headless corpse found near Heathrow in March 2008. It leads the team members to a lock-up belonging to a bodybuilder called Mark Rix, who died of a suspected heart attack the same year, so they start looking for connections between the original murder and Rix's death. They are helped in their investigation by anthropologist Fiona Kennedy, for whom Dan begins to develop feelings - just as he is told his wife might be discharged from the secure hospital where she has spent the past several years. Tracy-Ann Obermann and Liz White guest star

programme.title: The Boy That Never Was
programme.desc: Forced to put their own troubles to one side, Robin and Harry look to a local policeman for help with tracking down Ollie. Deep in the seedy underbelly of Essaouira's back streets, they follow a lead to a place that deals in drugs and trafficking of children and there they find a badly beaten Ollie

programme.title: Sister Boniface Mysteries
programme.desc: Top television spy series Operation QT is filming at the convent when a real bullet is fired instead of a replica, narrowly missing the leading actor. Working with DS Livingstone, Sister Boniface soon works out the real target was the show's producer, Dick Lansky, who has many enemies on and off set and a roving eye for the actresses. Lorna Watson stars
